findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization in setuptools
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization vulnerabilities in setuptools package

message.text: Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure temporary file creation
 * @description Using insecure temporary file functions like tempfile.mktemp can lead to race conditions
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insecure-temp-file
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-377
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember("mktemp").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("tempfile").getMember(["NamedTemporaryFile", "TemporaryFile"]).getACall() and
  not call.getArg(0).toString().matches("delete%") and
  not call.getArg(1).toString().matches("delete%")
select call, "Potentially insecure temporary file creation that could lead to race conditions or information disclosure."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure temporary file creation using tempfile.mktemp or similar functions

message.text: Potentially insecure temporary file creation that could lead to race conditions or information disclosure.
